data.description: Table with draggable column resize handles. Drag the right edge of any header to resize.

data.name: Table — Rich Cell Content
data.description: Table with rich cell content using Link for emails and Badge for role labels.

data.name: Table — Row Selection
data.description: Table with row selection checkboxes and a select-all header checkbox.

data.name: Table — Selection in the Leading Mark
data.description: Selection without a checkbox column: each item shows its avatar, and the checkbox takes the avatar slot while a mouse is over it, on keyboard focus, and everywhere once anything is selected; on touch screens it always shows. The state comes from useTableSelectionState, and the checkboxes render in the name column instead of the useTableSelection column, so checked items get no aria-selected or highlight; add them if needed.

data.name: Table — Sortable Columns
data.description: Table with sortable columns, click headers to sort ascending or descending.

data.name: Table — Striped Rows
data.description: Table with alternating row colors and hover highlighting for easy scanning.

data.name: Table: Bulk Actions
data.description: Controlled row selection with the reusable TableSelectionToolbar rendered in flow above the table. Product actions occupy the logical start; synchronized selection count and complete clear action occupy the logical end.

data.name: Table: Floating Bulk Actions
data.description: The reusable TableSelectionToolbar inside a capped, self-contained scroll region for a long non-sticky table below metric cards. The caller-owned sticky placement keeps actions 16px from the example scrollport without moving the table when selection changes.

data.name: TabList — Fill Layout
data.description: Tabs that stretch to fill the available width with a bottom divider.

data.name: TabList — With Actions
data.description: Page header pattern with tabs on the left and action buttons pushed to the right. When hasDivider is true, match the Button size to the TabList size so the tabs and actions align to a shared baseline above the divider.

data.name: TabList — With Badge
data.description: Tabs with notification badge counts rendered via endContent. Uses error variant for urgent counts and neutral for informational ones.

data.name: TabList — With Icons
data.description: Tabs with leading icons alongside text labels.

data.name: TabList — With Overflow Menu
data.description: Tab list with a dropdown menu for additional items that do not fit inline.

data.name: TabList — With Status Dot
data.description: Tabs with status dot indicators rendered via endContent to show live environment health at a glance.

data.name: TabMenu
data.description: TabMenu is an overflow menu within a TabList that groups additional tab options into a dropdown, showing the selected option's label as the trigger text.

data.name: TabMenu — Basic
data.description: An overflow menu at the end of a TabList that collects secondary tabs behind a dropdown. Use it when there are more tabs than fit comfortably inline.

data.name: Text — Colors
data.description: All text color options (primary, secondary, disabled, placeholder, active) applied to body text to show their intended use.

data.name: Text — Heading Levels
data.description: All 6 heading levels (h1 through h6) rendered with Heading to show the full type scale.

data.name: Text — Inline
data.description: Mixing body and code text inline within a single line using the default inline display mode.

data.name: Text — Truncation
data.description: Single-line and multi-line text truncation with ellipsis using maxLines in a width-constrained container.

data.name: Text — Types
data.description: All 5 semantic text types (body, large, label, supporting, code) with their default styling from the theme.

data.name: Text — Weight
data.description: The 4 font weight variants (normal, medium, semibold, bold) applied to body text.

data.name: Text — Word Break
data.description: Compares break-word and break-all word break modes on a long unbreakable string.

data.name: Text — Wrap
data.description: The 4 text-wrap modes (wrap, nowrap, balance, pretty) shown in width-constrained containers.

data.name: TextArea
data.description: A text area with placeholder text.

data.name: TextArea — Character Count
data.description: Textareas with maxLength and a live character counter. The counter turns red when the limit is exceeded.

data.name: TextArea — Icon
data.description: Textareas with a leading icon that hints at the expected content, like a chat bubble for messages or a pencil for notes.

data.name: TextArea — States
data.description: Required, disabled, and loading textareas side by side. Shows the interactive states the component supports.

data.name: TextArea — Validation
data.description: All three status variants (error, warning, and success) with status messages, plus error without a message. Use to show inline validation feedback as the user types.

data.name: TextInput — Icon
data.description: Inputs with a leading icon that hints at the expected content. Use when the icon helps users identify the field faster, like a lock for passwords or an envelope for email.

data.name: TextInput — Search
data.description: Search input with a hidden label, start icon, and clear button. Use for toolbar and header search bars where the icon provides sufficient context.

data.name: TextInput — Sizes
data.description: Small, medium, and large inputs side by side. Use small in dense UIs like table filters, medium for most forms, and large for prominent single-field pages.

data.name: TextInput — States
data.description: Error, warning, and success validation states with status messages. Use to show users what went wrong and how to fix it.

data.name: TextInput — Status variant
data.description: The statusVariant prop controls whether the status message is attached to the bordered input (default, overlapping directly below) or detached from it (floating below as a separate element with spacing).

data.name: TextInput — Types
data.description: Text, password, and email types plus field-level features: tooltip, required, optional, description, disabled, and loading.

data.name: Theme — Apply Theme
data.description: Wrap a subtree in Theme to apply a theme to every child component in that region.

data.name: Theme — Distinct Themes
data.description: Two visually distinct theme providers wrapping identical content to show how Theme changes the visual treatment of child components.

data.name: Theme — Nested Theme
data.description: Nested Theme providers let a local region use a different theme without affecting the rest of the page.

data.name: Theme — Switch Themes
data.description: Use state to switch the theme object passed to Theme and preview a different visual treatment.

data.name: Theme Showcase
data.description: Several unrelated product surfaces rendered together on one canvas so a token change can be judged across contexts at once. A comparison harness rather than a layout to ship.

data.name: Thumbnail
data.description: A thumbnail with an image and label.

data.name: Thumbnail — Disabled
data.description: Thumbnails in the disabled state with reduced opacity. The open and remove buttons stay focusable and announced as disabled, and call nothing.

data.name: Thumbnail — Gallery
data.description: A row of clickable thumbnails with labels that open a detail view. Use for image attachment lists where users need to preview and manage uploads.

data.name: Thumbnail — Removable
data.description: Thumbnails with a remove button overlay. The close button uses APCA luminance detection to stay visible on both dark and light images.

data.name: Thumbnail — States
data.description: All visual states side by side: image loaded, placeholder, skeleton loading, and upload overlay. Demonstrates the full lifecycle of a thumbnail from empty to loaded.

data.name: TimeInput
data.description: A time input that uses the browser/OS picker on touch by default and Astryx typed entry on fine pointers.

data.name: TimeInput — Constrained
data.description: Time inputs with min/max constraints limiting selection to specific windows. Use to prevent out-of-bounds selections for appointments, reservations, or shift scheduling.

data.name: TimeInput — Formats
data.description: 12-hour, 24-hour, and seconds formats side by side. Use 12h for US-centric UIs, 24h for international or technical contexts, and seconds for precise timing.

data.name: TimeInput — Increment
data.description: Time input with a custom step increment. Arrow keys jump by the specified interval (e.g. 15 minutes) for quick slot-based scheduling.

data.name: TimeInput — States
data.description: Default, disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use status messages to give users clear feedback about their time selection.

data.name: Timer — Formats
data.description: Elapsed compact units and stopwatch clock notation shown from the same start time.

data.name: Timer — Inline
data.description: A Timer composed into status copy while inheriting the surrounding typography.

data.name: Timer — Typography
data.description: Timer using its Timestamp-matched default typography and an emphasized override.

data.name: Timestamp — Auto
data.description: Auto format that shows relative time for recent dates and switches to the full date for older ones. The default choice for most use cases.

data.name: Timestamp — Colors
data.description: Timestamp rendered in each available color variant: primary, secondary, disabled, and active.

data.name: Timestamp — Formats
data.description: All display formats side by side: date, date_time, time, and their system equivalents. Use date and date_time for user-facing UI, system variants for logs and dev tools.

data.name: Timestamp — Relative
data.description: Relative time labels from seconds to months ago, with hover tooltips showing the full date. Use in feeds, comment threads, and activity logs.

data.name: Timestamp — Timezone
data.description: Timestamps with the timezone abbreviation appended. Enable isTimezoneShown for audiences across time zones, like audit logs or team calendars.

data.name: Timestamp — Tooltip time zones
data.description: Hover tooltips that show one instant across several time zones or formats. Use tooltipEntries when readers must compare zones, like an incident log carrying both the reader's time and the event's origin zone.

data.name: Toast
data.description: Imperative toast notifications triggered with useToast and rendered in the toast viewport.

data.name: Toast — Action
data.description: Persistent toasts with a trailing button or link so the user can act on the notification, like undoing a delete or viewing a report.

data.name: Toast — Deduplication
data.description: Prevent duplicate toasts with uniqueID. Use ignore to keep the first toast, or overwrite to replace it with updated content like a progress percentage.

data.name: Toast — Dismiss
data.description: Show a persistent toast and dismiss it programmatically using the function returned by useToast. Use for long-running operations that need manual cleanup.

data.name: Toast — Stacking
data.description: Multiple toasts stacking vertically with smooth enter and exit animations. Click repeatedly to see how toasts queue and dismiss.

data.name: Toast — Types
data.description: Info and error toast variants side by side. Info toasts auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, error toasts persist until the user dismisses them.

data.name: ToggleButton — Color
data.description: Toggle buttons with colored icons in the pressed state. Shows accent-colored toolbar formatting and semantic reaction colors (yellow star, red heart, blue bookmark).

data.name: ToggleButton — Group
data.description: Toggle button groups in single-select and multi-select modes. Single selection acts as a view mode switcher; multiple selection forms a formatting toolbar.

data.name: ToggleButton — Icon Swap
data.description: Icon-only toggle buttons that swap between outline and solid icons when pressed. Use for actions like favorite, bookmark, or mute where the icon itself communicates the state.

data.name: ToggleButton — Label
data.description: Toggle buttons with visible text labels that show a font weight shift on press. Use when the icon alone is not enough to communicate the action.

data.name: ToggleButton — States
data.description: Default, pressed, disabled, and loading states of a standalone toggle button. Shows how visual treatment changes across states.

data.name: ToggleButtonGroup
data.description: ToggleButtonGroup manages a set of ToggleButtons with single-select or multi-select behavior for options like view modes or filters.

data.name: ToggleButtonGroup — Vertical
data.description: A vertically stacked ToggleButtonGroup using the vertical orientation, shown with both single-select and multi-select behavior, ideal for sidebar-style option lists and vertical toolbars.

data.name: Token — Clickable
data.description: Interactive tokens that respond to clicks. Use for toggleable filters or tokens that open a detail view when selected.

data.name: Token — Colors
data.description: All 11 color variants in default and disabled states. Use color to categorize entities or convey status at a glance.

data.name: Token — End Content
data.description: Tokens with trailing content like a count badge or status indicator after the label. Use for notification counts, item quantities, or compact status info.

data.name: Token — Icon
data.description: Tokens with a leading icon that identifies the entity type. Use when the icon helps users recognize the token category faster, like a user icon for people or a tag icon for labels.

data.name: Token — Removable
data.description: Tokens with a dismiss button for selections the user can undo. Use in multi-select fields, active filters, or any list of user-chosen items.

data.name: Tokenizer
data.description: A tokenizer with preset tags and search source.

data.name: Tokenizer — Clear
data.description: Tokenizer with a built-in clear-all button for bulk removal of all selected tokens. On touch screens, clear through the sheet's Clear all.

data.name: Tokenizer — Creatable
data.description: Free-text tokenizer for creating custom tags and a combined create-or-search pattern. Use when users need to enter values that may not exist in a predefined list.

data.name: Tokenizer — End Content
data.description: Tokenizer with an action button in the end slot. Use for inline actions like applying selections alongside the input.

data.name: Tokenizer — Icon
data.description: Tokenizer with a leading search icon to visually reinforce the search behavior.

data.name: Tokenizer — Max Entries
data.description: Tokenizer with a maximum selection limit. The input hides automatically when the limit is reached, preventing further additions.

data.name: Tokenizer — Overflow
data.description: Tokenizer with overflow truncation when unfocused. Inline mode pushes content down on expand; layer mode overlays without shifting layout. Overflow modes apply to the inline field.

data.name: Tokenizer — States
data.description: Tokenizer in disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use to communicate validation feedback or lock a selection from editing.

data.name: Toolbar — Bulk Actions
data.description: A compact toolbar with the muted variant for showing bulk selection actions. Use when the user selects multiple items in a list or table and needs quick access to batch operations.

data.name: Toolbar — Card Header
data.description: A toolbar as a card header with a left-aligned title and icon actions on the right. Use Toolbar instead of LayoutHeader when your card header has interactive actions; Toolbar adds start/end slot layout, keyboard navigation, and automatic size cascading. If the header is just a title with no actions, a LayoutHeader or Section is enough.

data.name: Toolbar — Sizes
data.description: Small, medium, and large toolbars side by side. The size prop cascades to child buttons and inputs automatically. Use small in dense UIs like cards, medium for most cases, and large for spacious layouts.

data.name: Toolbar — Tab Navigation
data.description: A toolbar with tabs in the start slot and an action button at the end. Use as a card or section header when content is split into tabs with a primary action alongside.

data.name: Toolbar — Table Filter
data.description: Filter bar above a table: a search box leads the row, each field beside it is a closed trigger that doubles as its own filter chip — the bare field name unset, the whole clause once set — and the clauses fold from the end into a count as the row narrows, followed by a live result count, a clear all, and a column picker. Use to search, filter, and narrow flat rows of records such as jobs, orders, tickets, or users.

data.name: Toolbar — Three Slot
data.description: A toolbar with start, center, and end content using the three-column grid layout. Use when you need a centered title or heading with navigation and actions on either side.

data.name: Tooltip — Action Bar
data.description: Tooltips on an action button bar with contextual descriptions.

data.name: Tooltip — Hook Usage
data.description: Tooltip using the useTooltip hook for programmatic control.

data.name: Tooltip — Inline Text
data.description: Tooltips on inline text terms for definitions.

data.name: Top Nav
data.description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.

data.name: TopNav — Centered Navigation
data.description: Navigation layout with center-aligned nav items flanked by a logo heading and end actions.

data.name: TopNav — Enterprise Dashboard
data.description: Full-featured navigation bar with icon-labeled nav items, search, notifications, and a primary CTA.

data.name: TopNav — Hover Menu
data.description: Navigation bar with a hover-triggered dropdown menu showing product items with icons and descriptions.

data.name: TopNav — Mega Menu
data.description: Marketing-style navigation with a full-width mega menu featuring product items and a promotional featured card.

data.name: TopNav — Multiple Dropdowns
data.description: Navigation bar with multiple hover-triggered dropdown menus that auto-close when switching between them.

data.name: TopNav — With Logo
data.description: Navigation bar with a branded logo icon, heading link, nav items, and a profile action.

data.name: TopNavHeading
data.description: Demonstrates TopNavHeading with a logo and text, both as a plain display and as a clickable link.

data.name: TopNavHeading — Basic
data.description: A product heading with a logo inside a TopNav, linked to the home page. Use as the leading brand element of a top navigation bar.

data.name: TopNavItem
data.description: Demonstrates TopNavItem with selected, icon, disabled, and default states.

data.name: TopNavItem — Basic
data.description: Navigation links inside a TopNav with one item marked as selected. Use for top-level pages of an application.

data.name: TopNavMegaMenu
data.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenu with items and a featured card in the mega menu panel.

data.name: TopNavMegaMenu — Basic
data.description: A mega menu trigger inside a TopNav that opens a panel of rich link items. Use when a navigation section has multiple destinations worth describing.

data.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
data.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard with a title, description, and CTA link inside a mega menu.

data.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard — Basic
data.description: A promotional card with a title, description, and call-to-action link. Pass it to the featured slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to highlight announcements.

data.name: TopNavMegaMenuItem
data.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuItem with icons, titles, and descriptions inside a mega menu.

data.name: TopNavMegaMenuItem — Basic
data.description: Rich link items with an icon, title, and description. Use inside the items slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to describe each destination.

data.name: TopNavMenu
data.description: Demonstrates TopNavMenu with a hover-triggered dropdown containing items with icons and descriptions.

data.name: TopNavMenu — Basic
data.description: A dropdown menu inside a TopNav built from an items array with icons and descriptions. Use to group related destinations under a single trigger.

data.name: Tree List — Variants
data.description: The `variant` prop controls whether hierarchy guide lines are shown: `lineGuides` (default) draws connector lines between parent and child rows, while `noGuides` relies on indentation alone. It is orthogonal to `density`, which controls spacing.

data.name: Tree Table
data.description: Hierarchical table where every parent row rolls up from its children — a code repository whose folders show the newest commit beneath them, beside a detail sidebar and a rendered README. Columns resize, siblings sort within their own level, arrow keys walk the rows, and search prunes the tree to matching branches.

data.name: TreeList — File Tree With Icons
data.description: File browser tree with folder and document icons distinguishing directories from files.

data.name: TreeList — Interactive Settings
data.description: Settings tree with clickable items and a documentation link.

data.name: TreeList — Mailbox Tree
data.description: Email folder tree with unread badge counts.

data.name: TreeList — Navigation Tree
data.description: Navigation tree with a selected item for the current page.

data.name: Two-column Form
data.description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll. Flat, single submit, no steps.

data.name: Typeahead — Limited Results
data.description: Typeahead with a capped dropdown showing at most three results.

data.name: Typeahead — Search Field
data.description: Search input with icon and suggestions on focus.

data.name: Typeahead — With Helper Text
data.description: Typeahead with a description below the label.

data.name: Typeahead — With Validation
data.description: Typeahead with an error validation message.

data.name: TypeaheadItem
data.description: Typeahead with custom item rendering using TypeaheadItem for avatars and descriptions.

data.name: TypeaheadItem — Basic
data.description: A typeahead whose results are rendered with TypeaheadItem, adding a secondary description below each label. Use inside renderItem to keep custom results visually consistent.

data.name: useAnimator — Playing cards
data.description: A playing card that follows a drag: a gentle release springs it back on its release velocity, and a quick flick throws it away with momentum before the next card is dealt. A Discard button moves it off from the keyboard, fading it in place under Reduce Motion, and the discard is announced. Built only on the public useAnimator hook.

data.name: useAnnounce — Filter Result Count
data.description: A product filter that announces its result count with useAnnounce: once typing pauses for 500 ms, a screen reader hears "3 results" or "No results". The count has its own hasReplace instance, as the hook's docs advise for a changing value.

data.name: useAppShellMobile — Custom Mobile Trigger
data.description: Custom mobile navigation trigger built with useAppShellMobile. The trigger consumes the surrounding AppShell context instead of rendering its own shell.

data.name: useCalendarDays — Month Grid
data.description: A compact custom month view: a seven-column table built from the weeks and dayNames that useCalendarDays returns, with only as many rows as the month needs. Days from the previous and next months are dimmed, and a Week starts on control (Sunday or Monday) reorders both the header and the grid.

data.name: useClickableContainer — Clickable Project Card
data.description: A project card that useClickableContainer makes clickable anywhere: a click on the card follows its title link, while the Star button, the owner link and a text selection keep their own behavior, and Ctrl/Cmd+click or middle-click opens the project in a new tab.

data.name: useClipboard — Share Link
data.description: A share card that copies its invite link with useClipboard: the Copy button reads "Copied" while isCopied is true, a screen reader hears "Link copied", and a second press restarts the reset timer.

data.name: useCollapsible — Custom Disclosure
data.description: Custom disclosure UI built directly with useCollapsible for headless open/close state.

data.name: useCollator — Locale-aware Name Sort
data.description: A list of names sorted with the compare function from useCollator: accented and lowercase names land where a reader expects, and switching the provider locale to Swedish moves Å and Ö after Z.

data.name: useCombobox — Assign To Field
data.description: An "Assign to" TextInput and a list of Item rows, with the field, listbox and option props from useCombobox spread onto them: typing filters a list of teammates, ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the active option while focus stays in the input, Enter picks it and Escape closes the list.

data.name: useContainerReveal — Reveal-on-hover Row Actions
data.description: File rows keep their edit/delete actions hidden at rest and reveal them on hover or keyboard focus via useContainerReveal; the actions stay mounted and in the tab order.

data.name: useDragToSnapPoints — Playing card on three places
data.description: A playing card that a sideways drag moves between three places: a slow release settles on the nearest, a quick flick carries to the next, and a release moving back returns where it started. Buttons settle it from the keyboard, and the new place is announced. Built only on the public useDragToSnapPoints hook.

data.name: useFocusTrap — Quick Edit Panel
data.description: A custom quick-edit panel, not built on Dialog, that traps focus with useFocusTrap: focusFirst moves focus to its field on open, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it, Escape closes it through onEscape, and closing returns focus to the Quick edit button.

data.name: useGridFocus — Color Swatch Grid
data.description: A color swatch picker in rows of eight with one Tab stop. useGridFocus moves focus with the arrow keys, Home and End, and Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End. Each swatch is a button, so Enter or a click picks it.

data.name: useHotkeys — Search and Help Shortcuts
data.description: Page shortcuts registered with useHotkeys: "/" focuses the search field and "?" opens the shortcut help, while typing either character in the field just types it. A switch turns the single-key shortcuts off through isDisabled.

data.name: useHoverCard — Profile Preview
data.description: Custom profile preview using useHoverCard with direct trigger and render control.

data.name: useIcon — Status Row
data.description: A custom status row that draws the semantic success, warning and error icons with useIcon. The same row renders under the current theme and under a Theme whose icons override those three, and its icons change with no change to the component.

data.name: useImageMode — Photo Caption
data.description: A photo banner with a caption over the sky. useImageMode samples only the strip under the caption and MediaTheme switches the caption between light and dark text from the result. A Beach photo switch swaps a night photo for a bright beach photo, and while the new photo loads the caption keeps the dark fallback.

data.name: useInputContainer — Search Field Wrapper
data.description: A custom search field wrapper with a leading search icon, padding and a trailing Clear button. useInputContainer puts focus in the input when the icon or the padding is clicked, while a click on Clear empties the field without the wrapper taking it over.

data.name: useInputStatusIcon — Coupon Code Status
data.description: A custom bordered coupon-code input whose status affordance comes from useInputStatusIcon. A wrong code shows the error status and SAVE20 shows success. Switching the variant moves between a plain glyph with a message below (attached), no icon on the field (detached), and a focusable button whose tooltip keyboard and screen-reader users can reach, with its aria-describedby id returned by the hook (tooltip).

data.name: useKeyboardHint — Arrow-key Hint
data.description: A custom five-star rating with one Tab stop calls useKeyboardHint directly: tabbing into it shows a "← → to navigate" hint, the first arrow press dismisses it, and tabbing back in does not show it again.

data.name: useLayer — Anchored Layer
data.description: Low-level anchored overlay rendered with useLayer and a custom surface.

data.name: useLightbox — Gallery Grid
data.description: Photo gallery thumbnail grid using useLightbox for trigger props, keyboard navigation, and open state.

data.name: useLinkComponent — Article Cards
data.description: A custom Article card renders its title link with the component useLinkComponent resolves: the as prop first, then the nearest LinkProvider, then a native anchor. Inside a LinkProvider wired to a client-side router, the title navigates without a page load and updates the router location. With as="a" the title is a native anchor even inside the provider, and outside the provider it falls back to the next provider up or a native anchor.

data.name: useListFocus — Recent Files
data.description: A "Recent files" list of buttons with keyboard navigation from useListFocus: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move between rows, Home and End jump to the first and last row, focus wraps at the ends, and only one row is in the tab order.

data.name: useLocale — Invoice Summary
data.description: An invoice summary that formats its date and amount with Intl using the locale from useLocale, so switching the provider from English to German changes "Nov 2, 2026" and "$1,234.50" to "2. Nov. 2026" and "1.234,50 $" with no second locale source.

data.name: useMergedRefs — AutoGrowTextArea
data.description: An AutoGrowTextArea that forwards the caller's ref and also keeps its own ref to measure scrollHeight. The merged ref attaches both to the same textarea: it resizes itself while a parent button focuses it through the forwarded ref.

data.name: useMultiCombobox — Issue Labels
data.description: A Labels field built on useMultiCombobox: typing filters the labels, the arrow keys move the active option while focus stays in the field, Enter or a click toggles a label and the list stays open, and selected labels show as removable tokens above the field.

data.name: useOutlineFromMarkdown — Docs Article
data.description: A docs-style article with an Outline next to it, built from the same Markdown string through useOutlineFromMarkdown. "Add section" appends a heading to the string, and a new entry that links to it appears in the outline.

data.name: useOverflow — Editor Toolbar
data.description: Resize the card: useOverflow moves the toolbar actions that do not fit into a More menu, and shows them again when the card gets wider.

data.name: useOverlay — Product Quick View
data.description: A product card that is its own overlay container: useOverlay returns the ref and props to spread on the Card and a bottom strip to render once over the image. Hovering the card, or moving keyboard focus into it, slides in a Quick view button along the bottom of the image, and leaving hides it again. The image is a link that the strip leaves clickable above it, and Tab lands on it first so the next Tab reaches Quick view.

data.name: usePanGesture — A draggable box
data.description: The smallest pan example, in two forms side by side: the usePanGesture hook and the createPanGesture factory. The factory takes any element, React or not. Each card names its API, follows a drag from a finger, a mouse or a pen, and springs back, with the same StyleX styles. A starting point for a draggable tile, a swipe or any drag-and-release gesture.

data.name: usePanGesture — A playing card (advanced)
data.description: An advanced usePanGesture example: a playing card follows a drag, settles back on a gentle release and flies off on a quick flick, while a Discard button deals the next card from the keyboard and announces it. Drag, settle and throw are StyleX styles driven by React state. A pattern for swipe-to-dismiss, card decks and flick gestures.

data.name: usePopover — Quick Actions
data.description: Custom quick-actions popover using usePopover for trigger refs, ARIA attributes, and focus trapping.

data.name: usePressFeedback — Pressable Card
data.description: A Card made pressable with usePressFeedback: its marker and the interactionOverlayStyles backgroundImage overlay go straight on the Card, so a press darkens the card the way every Astryx pressable does; focusOutlineStyles.focusVisible gives it the shared Astryx focus ring for keyboard focus; and a click, Enter or Space flips it.

data.name: useScrollableArea — Activity Log Panel
data.description: A fixed-height Activity log panel whose entries scroll up and down. useScrollableArea makes the panel a keyboard tab stop only when its entries overflow, reports which edges have more entries so a top or bottom shadow shows only there, and keeps a scroll that reaches the end from scrolling the page. Add entry flips the panel from not scrollable to scrollable.

data.name: useScrollLock — Full-screen Mobile Menu
data.description: A custom full-screen menu opened from a Menu button. useScrollLock pins the page behind it while it is open, so the page does not scroll or shift sideways, and closing the menu returns the reader to the same scroll position.

data.name: useScrollOverflow — Filter Strip Edge Fades
data.description: A row of active filters that scrolls sideways. useScrollOverflow reports which edge has hidden filters, and the strip fades only that edge: none while every filter fits, the end at the start, both mid-scroll and the start at the end. Adding or removing a filter updates the fades, and in a right-to-left layout the start edge is on the right.

data.name: useSnapPaging — Onboarding Pages
data.description: Onboarding cards in a Carousel with hasSnap={useSnapPaging()}: under a finger or a trackpad swipe, each flick moves one view and rests on a card's start edge. A switch picks one view or one card per flick through the hook's pages option.

data.name: useStreamingText — Streaming Response
data.description: Smooth bursty generated text into a steady reveal with useStreamingText.

data.name: useTableColumnResize — Draggable Columns
data.description: A Table using useTableColumnResize. Drag the right edge of any column header to resize; widths are committed on release. The last proportional column flexes to fill remaining space.

data.name: useTableGroupedRows — Collapsible Groups
data.description: A table grouped into collapsible sections with useTableGroupedRows. Each group gets a full-width header with a chevron, label, and member count; click to collapse/expand.

data.name: useTableRowExpansion — Tree Table
data.description: A tree table using useTableRowExpansion with inherited columns. Child rows use the same columns as parents, indented by depth. Click the chevron or right-click to expand/collapse.

data.name: useTableRowIndex — Numbered Rows
data.description: A table with a prepended row-number column via useTableRowIndex. Numbering is monospaced, right-aligned, and follows the rendered data order.

data.name: useTableRowStatus - Semantic and Custom Markers
data.description: A job table using both row-status paths: status resolves themed semantic glyphs and tones, while color stays a custom paint choice with an optional caller-selected icon or the stable dot.

data.name: useTableSortableState — Multi-Sort Orders
data.description: Orders with no sort code of their own: useTableSortableState owns the sort state, returns the sorted orders, and hands useTableSortable a ready config. Click Customer, then Shift-click Total, to sort by customer and then by total within each customer. A line above the orders reads the current sort state from the hook.

data.name: useTableStickyColumns — Pinned Columns
data.description: A Table using useTableStickyColumns to pin the Name column to the start edge and Status to the end edge. Scroll horizontally; pinned columns stay in view with a soft shadow over the scrolling content.

data.name: useTableTreeData: Tree Table
data.description: A file-tree table built from nested data. useTableTreeState flattens the tree into the visible rows and owns the expanded set; useTableTreeData draws the per-level indent and the expand/collapse chevron in the tree column. The two hooks are designed to work together, so this one example covers both. hasExpandAllControl adds the expand-all/collapse-all toggle to the tree column header. Collapsed branches are unmounted, not hidden.

data.name: useTheme — Token Values
data.description: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.

data.name: useToast — Settings Saved
data.description: Shows a toast from the function useToast returns: a "Settings saved" confirmation with an Undo action, a uniqueID so pressing the button again replaces the toast instead of stacking another, and an error toast when the request fails.

data.name: useTranslator — Load More Footer
data.description: A "Load more" footer under a list that gets its button label and its "Showing 3 of 9" count from the function useTranslator returns, with app message keys supplied per locale through InternationalizationProvider, so switching the provider to French changes both strings.

data.name: useTreeFocus — Keyboard File Tree
data.description: A custom file tree built from plain rows with tree roles. useTreeFocus gives it the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move over the visible rows, ArrowRight opens a folder or moves into it, ArrowLeft closes it or moves to its parent, Home and End jump to the ends, a typed letter jumps to a matching name, Enter opens a file, and only one row is in the tab order.

data.name: useTypeahead — Type to Focus a Country
data.description: A country list of buttons with useListFocus arrow keys and useTypeahead type-to-focus. Typing "can" focuses Canada, pressing "b" again and again cycles through Belgium, Brazil and Bulgaria, and "e" finds Éire with the accent ignored. The hook only reports the match through onMatch, and useListFocus moves focus.

data.name: Vertical Wizard
data.description: Multi-step wizard with the steps in a fixed left rail that stays visible while the form scrolls, plus a side panel whose guidance follows the focused field. Suits long or unequal steps carrying uploads, previews, and dense review metadata. As width tightens the guidance drops first, then the rail rotates into a horizontal stepper above the form.

data.name: VisuallyHidden — Live Region
data.description: A polite aria-live region announces visual-only state changes to assistive technology.

data.name: VisuallyHidden — Structural Heading
data.description: Give a visually implicit section an accessible name so screen-reader users can navigate to it.

data.name: VisuallyHidden — Supplementary Context
data.description: Stat cards whose trend arrows get screen-reader-only text, so a change like +12% is read as an increase from last month. Use to make terse visual data accessible.

data.name: VStack
data.description: Demonstrates VStack arranging items vertically with different gaps.

data.name: VStack — Basic
data.description: A heading and paragraphs stacked vertically with a consistent gap. Use VStack whenever siblings should flow top to bottom with even spacing.

data.name: Width budget: pixels or any CSS length
data.description: Compare a numeric pixel width with rem and percentage lengths. The width budget also caps the drawer on mobile.

data.name: With close button
data.description: Pass onOpenChange to render a close button that calls it with false. Drawer renders no close button of its own, so this is the usual visible way to close.

data.name: With subtitle and end content
data.description: Add a subtitle under the title and put a status, such as a Badge, in endContent. The close button stays at the end of the row.

data.name: Work Item Detail
data.description: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail with assignee, dates, labels, and linked items. The shape for any tracked item with children, properties, and a comment history — a task, ticket, issue, story, bug, card, request, or work item.
